svg.title: The team inspects an empty pump site that records say is installed and working.
svg.desc: An empty plinth, capped pipe, and drain ending in rubble fill the foreground. Vale crouches to inspect the physical site while Riju reads a paid and tested account trail; active cameras and empty towers stand behind.
